cells.quote: After teaching, the mean accuracy of bacterial keratitis in the G2 group (65.68% ± 18.79%) was significantly lower than the G3 group (79.33% ± 18.93%) (P = 0.002, post hoc test), but the improvement of accuracy was not significantly different (23.51% ± 22.76% and 27.33% ± 27.03%, respectively).
cells.note: No standardized effect size was reported for the post-teaching bacterial-keratitis comparison.
